description: Puts the person in one of the user's photos somewhere else, keeping their pose and framing, paid from their credits: scene is one of the app's scenes, or text says the place in up to 300 characters; a scene wins when both come. Text is rewritten before anything is made: what Luala doesn't make is left out, a look like a named person becomes that styling, and the result's text is what was sent. Pass the price the user agreed to as max_credits: the photo's prices from get_shoot or list_photos name it. If a call to this tool got no answer, it may already have started: check list_photos before calling it again.
name: replace_background
title: Replace a photo's background
